description: Every API-priced call site (OpenAI incl. Codex CLI and Agents SDK, Gemini, World Labs, hosted SAM, Anthropic, NVIDIA NIM, DeepInfra, DreamLabs, Palatial, RunPod serverless) found by scripts/verify_paid_resource_allocator.py. Keys are path::enclosing scope::signal. admitted: via (where the path reaches it) and admission (the admission, reservation or ledger function), both path::name. not_paid: reason. unadmitted: can_spend_on, and the key must be named in UNADMITTED_API_CALL_SITES, which tests/test_paid_resource_allocator_verifier.py pins (adding one needs an explicit edit to that test). admitted means the admission, reservation or ledger call runs before the paid request on every path.
